races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict: MISS MONA KEEBA shaped very well when second of 21 over C&D on debut a fortnight ago, travelling best before perhaps going on too soon, and with improvement expected she is fancied to go one better. Tequila Belle is feared most after finishing a couple of places behind her that day and Villaray also respected despite the trip possibly being on the sharp side. MISS MONA KEEBA (IRE) TEQUILA BELLE (IRE) VILLARAY (IRE)

races.display_title: Christmas Parties At Navan Racecourse 5th & 13th December Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: CARRIGANS GROVE has hinted at a revival on her last 2 starts and is taken to capitalise on a reduced mark with cheekpieces back on. Rodeeve is feared most if backing up her C&D third last time ahead of El Fontenaro . Well-treated course specialist Step Back In Time and Alnofoor completing the shortlist. CARRIGANS GROVE (IRE) RODEEVE EL FONTENARO (IRE)

races.display_title: Unibet Interactive 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: The well-related WOOTTON KING produced a very promising first effort when second in a C&D maiden 3 weeks ago, showing greenness before doing his best work at the finish. In leading hands and rating a sure-fire improver, he can go one place better here. Andrew Balding saddles a pair of interesting newcomers in the shape of Chariots of Fire and Bayside Waltz and the betting can likely decipher their chances. WOOTTON KING CHARIOTS OF FIRE (IRE) BAYSIDE WALTZ (IRE)

races.verdict: A competitive nursery with the narrow vote in favour of GREAT OAK . A winner of a match race on debut at Ayr, he had viable excuses for a below-par showing at Haydock next time and he surely remains capable of better now handicapping from what looks a workable opening mark. races.display_title: Try Unibet's Improved Acca Boosts Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: NZURI was totally unfancied in the betting when winning twice recently but there was no fluke about it having been up with a solid pace throughout each time and she's taken to bring up the hat-trick at the expense of Happier who may find stall 10 a stumbling block. Lady Mariko and Magna are ones to keep an eye on from attractive marks. NZURI HAPPIER (IRE) LADY MARIKO

races.verdict: RIDGER has looked a different beast in recent weeks so Ollie Sangster's progressive 3-y-o is selected to complete the hat-trick at the expense of Iconic Times , who also arrives on a hat-trick but has been off 11 weeks since scrambling home at Catterick. Dark Mandate and Viking Glory are another couple worthy of consideration, too. RIDGER (IRE) ICONIC TIMES DARK MANDATE
